# REDCORE — Full Business Context for LLMs

REDCORE is a concrete cutting and core drilling contractor based in Agawam, Massachusetts, serving residential and commercial customers across Massachusetts and New England.

## Contact Information
- Business: REDCORE (Red Core / REDCORE Concrete)
- Phone: +1 (413) 666-2026 (available 24/7)
- Email: redcoreusa@gmail.com
- Address: 321 Springfield St, Agawam, MA 01001, USA
- Website: https://redcoreconcrete.com

## Services
1. Core Drilling — diamond core drilling of perfectly round holes (1"–14"+) in reinforced concrete, brick, CMU, and stone for HVAC, plumbing, electrical, and utility lines.
   URL: https://redcoreconcrete.com/core-drilling
2. Slab Cutting — flat sawing of concrete slabs for trenches, openings, and removal.
   URL: https://redcoreconcrete.com/slab-cutting
3. Wall Saw Cutting — track-mounted wall sawing for doors, windows, and openings in vertical concrete.
   URL: https://redcoreconcrete.com/wall-saw-cutting
4. Demolition & Cutting — controlled demolition and concrete removal with debris cleanup.
   URL: https://redcoreconcrete.com/demolition-cutting
5. Concrete Restoration — crack repair, resurfacing, polishing, and protective sealing.
   URL: https://redcoreconcrete.com/concrete-restoration

## Service Areas
Massachusetts: Agawam, Springfield, West Springfield, Holyoke, Northampton, Pittsfield, Worcester, Boston, Lynnfield.
Also: Connecticut, Rhode Island, New Hampshire, Vermont, Maine.

## Offers
Current promotions include discounted concrete step polishing/restoration with free sealer, flat-rate door/egress openings, volume core drilling pricing, discounted demolition with free debris cleanup, wall saw cutting discounts, and slab cutting specials. See https://redcoreconcrete.com/#offers

## Key Facts
- Free estimates.
- 24/7 availability.

- Uses diamond cutting technology for precise, low-damage cuts.
- Project galleries are published on each service page.

## Frequently Asked Questions
Q: Do you offer free estimates?
A: Yes, free estimates are available 24/7 by phone at (413) 666-2026.

Q: What areas do you serve?
A: Massachusetts and surrounding New England states including Connecticut, Rhode Island, New Hampshire, Vermont, and Maine.

Q: What is core drilling used for?
A: Creating round holes in concrete for pipes, cables, HVAC ducts, and utility lines.

Q: Do you handle demolition debris?
A: Yes, demolition services include debris cleanup (see current offers).
